name: wall-discriminator-five
purpose: Compiler A/B on the ISA-freeze wall tasks. The world is frozen: every task here is one where K2.7 already had the observation and the operation available and still failed. Success is a write where K2.7 format-exited, an insert_row where inspect listed the index, or a skip of a gold-blank extra -- not a higher exact count. Run the same config for every compiler; do not tune the world between arms.
